dog.description_text:
My Foster writes:
Trina is the cutest cuddle bug you'll ever meet! She loves to melt into your arms and give you endless licks while you pet her. She also enjoys following you around your home and even joining you in the bathroom. While she loves your company, she's also happy to stay home on her own as long as she has a few toys to play with. Some of her favorite things to play with? Paper and cardboard she can shred! One of her sweetest qualities is that she adores other dogs. Trina loves to see them outside and loves to sleep right next to (or on top of) my resident dog. While she needs help building her confidence outside and with strangers, she would love a home and a doggy sibling to call her own :)

Pop-Up Promo! ACC is over capacity, so I'm currently living in a pop-up crate. My adoption fees are waived, and my adoption comes with a $50 Chewy gift card.

What my friends at ACC say about me:

I would do best in a home with only adult humans.

I prefer to call the shots and enjoy coming to you when I'm ready for pets.

I don't always like to share my food, toys or bedding with other animals.
dog.name: Trina
